description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {U} and exiling it to Void Maw.
Activate Void Maw by returning Priest of Gix to your graveyard, giving Void Maw +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Dreams of the Dead for {1}{U}, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix ETBs, add {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
